title: Who Will Write Our History
creator: Roberta Grossman
description: Documentary with re-enactments about historian Emanuel Ringelblum’s secret group, which buried an archive of ghetto life in milk cans. Two of its three caches were dug up after the war. Parts are on show at the Jewish Historical Institute.

title: The Zookeeper’s Wife
creator: Niki Caro
description: Jessica Chastain plays Antonina Żabińska, who with her husband Jan sheltered Jews in Warsaw Zoo during the occupation. Shot in Prague, not Warsaw. The real zoo is in Praga, the district on the Vistula’s east bank, and the Żabińskis’ villa is open.

title: The Pianist
creator: Roman Polański
description: Roman Polański’s film of Władysław Szpilman’s memoir, with Adrien Brody as the pianist. In 1942 his family was sent from the Umschlagplatz, the ghetto’s railway loading yard, to Treblinka. A white marble memorial stands there on Stawki Street.

title: Warsaw Uprising
creator: Jan Komasa
description: Real colour and black-and-white footage shot by Home Army cameramen in 1944, edited into a story of two young reporters, with voices added by lip-readers. Made by Jan Komasa with the Warsaw Rising Museum, which shows the original reels.

title: Kanał
creator: Andrzej Wajda
description: Andrzej Wajda’s film about a Home Army company escaping through the sewers (kanały) as the 1944 Uprising collapses. Bleak and short. On Dworkowa Street a memorial marks the manhole where Germans shot more than 100 insurgents as they climbed out.

title: The Cruise
creator: Marek Piwowski
description: Marek Piwowski’s cult comedy, originally Rejs. Stowaways on a Vistula pleasure boat elect a committee and hold absurd meetings, a sly picture of communist life. Mostly amateur actors. Poles quote it constantly. The boat sails from Warsaw’s riverbank.

title: 4 Alternative Street
creator: Stanisław Bareja
description: Stanisław Bareja’s TV satire, originally Alternatywy 4: a petty building caretaker bullies the tenants of a new tower block. Censors held it back until 1986. It was shot in the big concrete estates of Ursynów, in south Warsaw. Nine episodes.

title: Leave No Traces
creator: Jan P. Matuszyński
place: Jezuicka Street police station, Old Town
description: In 1983 militia officers beat student Grzegorz Przemyk to death in a police station on Jezuicka Street, in the Old Town. The state then spent years covering it up. This film follows the friend who saw it. Long, at nearly three hours.

title: Dekalog
creator: Krzysztof Kieślowski
description: Krzysztof Kieślowski’s ten one-hour films, each loosely on one of the Ten Commandments, about people in a single grey 1980s housing estate. Shot on the Stawki estate on the edge of Muranów, built over the ruins of the ghetto.
